evidence.quote: HeiQ is a Swiss deeptech materials innovator founded in 2005 as a spin‑off from ETH Zurich, developing disruptive technologies across advanced materials, biotechnology, and sustainable solutions for global industries. || HeiQ Materials AG Ruetistrasse 12 8952 Schlieren (Zurich) Switzerland || HeiQ develops biotechnology‑enabled chemistries for textiles, home care, personal care, water, and animal care.
